title: Your boss wants to bring AI into your workplace. What do workers get?
discussion_signal: The discussion connects AI deployment to monitoring, discipline, job redesign, retraining, workload, and bargaining over who receives productivity gains. Replies include both surveillance concerns and examples of useful AI adoption.
linked_research_question: How does AI adoption change worker monitoring, task control, skill formation, workload, voice, and bargaining power?
limits: Normative proposals are not evidence of implementation
No employer-side deployment or worker panel is supplied
